policy: Every discovered network path in web/ is classified. Existing shell files are served locally by staticResponse; absent/generated assets, relative shell fetches and literal skin-host app reads require explicit catalogue entries. Unknown paths fail closed and are collected. Dynamic URL construction still requires the runtime fence.

transports.XMLHttpRequest: none in the three flows (refused if issued)
transports.EventSource: run event streams only start after a send; none of the flows send, so /wizard/hermes/v1/runs/{}/events is not-exercised and any stream is refused
transports.WebSocket: every socket is closed by routeWebSocket; none catalogued

morning.note: Pinned checkout is loaded only by qa-instant-ui-taps (serves ready.json, shell.js, shell.css, /morning/api/status|hide inline with the pinned bytes). Other harnesses see the declaration as unavailable.

wisdom.note: Registry record only; no ready-extension, no frame opened.

/wizard-os-home/api/diagnostics/scroll-c.note: Android-native storage diagnostics only; these three browser flows have no native bridge. Privacy projection and collector transport are covered by capture-storage-diagnostics.test.mjs and an explicit synthetic private-collector probe. Refuse and collect any unexpected attempt here.
